t: This is a mural in Stockwell commemorating Violette Szabo and the local residents. It was made by the artist Brian Barnes, who was appointed an MBE in 2005 for services to the community in Battersea. Szabo was a British-French agent of the Special Operations Executive in the Second World War. On her second mission into occupied France she was captured, interrogated and tortured, then deported to Ravensbrück, where she was executed. She received the George Cross after her death.
